story: NFR Workspace: from firefighting to prepared judgement
proposition: NFR Workspace: one role-based experience, powered by reusable NFR methods, governed execution, a connected NFR core and approved integrations
anchorJourney: Third-party risk, shown in the live product

screens.title: From firefighting to prepared judgement.
screens.subtitle: One workspace per NFR role that connects every system's content, so AI prepares the full picture and professionals decide.
screens.question: What will this conversation show me?

screens.title: NFR work arrives as a question, not a method.
screens.subtitle: Questions come from everywhere, and each needs several sources, a method and an owner.
screens.closingLine: Four everyday questions. None of them is quick to answer.
screens.question: What does the risk function keep being asked?

screens.title: Regulation changes from above. Practice drifts from below.
screens.subtitle: The professional keeps the chain from obligation to decision together, by hand.
screens.closingLine: Not regulation, not people: rules re-mapped by hand and drift unseen until audit.
screens.question: Why is it hard to answer today?

screens.title: Standalone AI sees one system. NFR needs the whole picture.
screens.subtitle: Each assistant answers from its own system. The NFR answer needs all of them.
screens.closingLine: Each assistant sees a slice. The decision needs the whole picture.
screens.question: Do we not have AI already?

screens.title: One Workspace. Four ways to get work done.
screens.subtitle: The right capability depends on the work. Same identity, permissions, evidence and control record.
screens.closingLine: Not every question needs an agent. Not every agent should become an application.
screens.question: What is NFR Workspace?

screens.title: AI scales when work, process and data move together.
screens.subtitle: A better AI tool alone gives another pilot. NFR Workspace moves all three, one role at a time.
screens.closingLine: A better interface alone is not transformation.
screens.question: What has to change to scale it?

screens.title: Enter NFR Workspace.
screens.subtitle: The real product on synthetic records: one role, one working day, one complete controlled loop.
screens.closingLine: The live product is the evidence. This screen is only the doorway.
screens.question: What does the working day look like?

screens.title: Every number in that answer was calculated, not guessed.
screens.subtitle: Rules did the maths, AI explained it against the sources, and a person approved it.
screens.closingLine: Small steps you can test, instead of one model you have to trust.
screens.question: What happened beneath the experience?

screens.title: One failed test shows everything it affects.
screens.subtitle: Records live in different systems. Connected, the impact shows the same day, not at audit.
screens.closingLine: A change in one place reveals what else is affected.
screens.question: How does the answer stay true?

screens.title: AI prepares. Professionals decide. Systems record.
screens.subtitle: In the demonstration: AI drafted the request, you approved it, the system recorded it.
screens.question: What does AI do, and what stays human?

screens.title: Prove better risk outcomes, and the capacity returned.
screens.subtitle: Three things improve, each measured on its own from your baseline. None of them is headcount.
screens.closingLine: Value grows as assistance becomes controlled operational work.
screens.question: What is the value?

screens.title: Qualify in five weeks. Prove the loop in six months.
screens.subtitle: Start small and earn each step: one question, then one working loop, then reuse.
screens.closingLine: Not an enterprise-wide replacement: one journey, one loop, then reuse.
screens.question: What do we commit to first?

screens.title: The approach has been applied before.
screens.subtitle: Accenture experience with the same methods, in control inventories, ICT and cyber controls and assessment challenge.
screens.closingLine: Experience of the delivery team, not of the product.
screens.question: Has this been done before?

screens.title: Which role, decision and process becomes the first loop?
screens.subtitle: Agree four things today, and the proof that would authorise the next wave.
screens.closingLine: Start with one role, one bounded decision journey and one measurable loop.
screens.question: Where do we start?

screens.title: The five acts, captured from the product.
screens.subtitle: The same synthetic records and screens as the live Workspace. Space steps through; at the end, the story continues.
screens.closingLine: Fallback for the live demonstration: same data, same labels, same screens.
screens.question: What if the live product is unavailable?
screens.evidenceLabel: CAPTURED FROM NFR WORKSPACE · SYNTHETIC DATA
